```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(CVXR)
library(GWmodel)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(here)
library(sf)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
project_dir <- here()
data_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "data")
figure_output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "figures", "gw_model")
data_output_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "predicted_data", "gw_model")
model_output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "code", "R", "model", "gw_model")

dir.create(figure_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(data_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(model_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

### Load data

The regression data supplies historical GRDP per capita and centroid locations. The level-2 prediction data supplies 2025 covariates and centroid locations. Populations in the regression data are recorded in thousands, while level-2 populations are in persons, so regression population is converted to persons before standardization.

```{r}
regression_data <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "training_data/regression_dataset.csv")
)
prediction_data <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "training_data/prediction_dataset.csv")
)
provincial_grdp_data <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "_vnm_indicators/vnm_GRDPpc.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
provincial_population_data <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "_vnm_indicators/vnm_population.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

regression_data$population <- regression_data$population * 1000
provincial_population_data[["2025"]] <-
  provincial_population_data[["2025"]] * 1000

if (any(!is.finite(regression_data$year)) ||
    any(!is.finite(regression_data$grdp_per_capita))) {
  stop("Regression years and GRDP-per-capita responses must be finite.")
}
if (any(!is.finite(regression_data$latitude)) ||
    any(!is.finite(regression_data$longitude))) {
  stop("Regression centroid coordinates must be finite.")
}
```

### Preliminaries

Let \(y_{it}\) be GRDP per capita for observation \(i\) in year \(t\), and let \(x_{it}\) contain the standardized radiance, population, and pixel-count predictors. Let \(s_i\) denote the observation's longitude/latitude centroid. The year-specific intercepts \(\alpha_t\) play the same role as the year effects in the ridge model. In geographically weighted regression, the intercepts and slopes are estimated locally at each location \(s\):

\[
y_{it} = \alpha_t(s) + x_{it}^{\mathsf T}\beta(s) + \epsilon_{it}.
\]

At each location, observations receive bisquare weights determined by great-circle distance to that location and an adaptive bandwidth. The CVXR implementation solves the same local weighted least-squares problem. Its optional ridge penalty applies only to the predictor slopes, not to the intercept or year effects:

\[
\min_{\alpha(s),\,\beta(s)}
\sum_i w_i(s)\left(y_i-\alpha_{t_i}(s)-x_i^{\mathsf T}\beta(s)\right)^2
+\lambda\|\beta(s)\|_2^2.
\]

The models are fitted on 2020–2024 and the 2025 observations are kept out of fitting. As in the ridge model, 2025's year effect is not estimated from its holdout outcomes. Instead, the 2020–2024 year effects are linearly extrapolated to 2025 using the training-year trend weights. Those same weights are used to choose the adaptive bandwidth (and CVXR penalty) by 2025 holdout RMSE. After tuning, the models are refitted on all years and use the 2025 year effect for level-2 prediction.

```{r}
training_years <- 2020:2024
holdout_year <- 2025
all_years <- sort(unique(regression_data$year))
feature_columns <- c("mean_radiance", "population", "pixel_count")
scaled_feature_columns <- paste0(feature_columns, "_scaled")

training_data <- regression_data[
  regression_data$year %in% training_years,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
holdout_data <- regression_data[
  regression_data$year == holdout_year,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
if (!identical(sort(unique(training_data$year)), training_years) ||
    nrow(holdout_data) == 0) {
  stop("The regression data must contain 2020–2024 training and 2025 holdout rows.")
}

feature_means <- vapply(training_data[feature_columns], mean, numeric(1))
feature_sds <- vapply(training_data[feature_columns], sd, numeric(1))
if (any(!is.finite(feature_sds)) || any(feature_sds <= 0)) {
  stop("All model features must have positive, finite training standard deviations.")
}

prepare_features <- function(data) {
  for (feature in feature_columns) {
    data[[paste0(feature, "_scaled")]] <-
      (data[[feature]] - feature_means[[feature]]) /
      feature_sds[[feature]]
  }
  data
}

temporal_extrapolation_weights <-
  rep(1 / length(training_years), length(training_years)) +
  (holdout_year - mean(training_years)) *
    (training_years - mean(training_years)) /
    sum((training_years - mean(training_years))^2)
names(temporal_extrapolation_weights) <- as.character(training_years)

add_year_effects <- function(data, effect_years, extrapolation_weights = NULL) {
  for (year in effect_years[-1]) {
    column <- paste0("year_", year)
    if (is.null(extrapolation_weights)) {
      data[[column]] <- as.numeric(data$year == year)
    } else {
      data[[column]] <- unname(extrapolation_weights[as.character(year)])
    }
  }
  data
}

training_data <- add_year_effects(
  prepare_features(training_data),
  training_years
)
holdout_data <- add_year_effects(
  prepare_features(holdout_data),
  training_years,
  temporal_extrapolation_weights
)
prediction_data <- prepare_features(prediction_data)

year_effect_columns <- paste0("year_", training_years[-1])
model_predictors <- c(year_effect_columns, scaled_feature_columns)
design_formula <- reformulate(model_predictors)
model_formula <- reformulate(model_predictors, response = "grdp_per_capita")

X_train <- model.matrix(design_formula, data = training_data)
X_holdout <- model.matrix(design_formula, data = holdout_data)
y_train <- training_data$grdp_per_capita
y_holdout <- holdout_data$grdp_per_capita
feature_parameter_indices <- match(scaled_feature_columns, colnames(X_train))
if (anyNA(feature_parameter_indices)) {
  stop("Could not identify all standardized feature slopes in the model matrix.")
}
holdout_total_sum_squares <- sum((y_holdout - mean(y_holdout))^2)
if (!is.finite(holdout_total_sum_squares) || holdout_total_sum_squares <= 0) {
  stop("The 2025 holdout outcomes must have positive finite variance.")
}

training_coordinates <- as.matrix(
  training_data[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
)
holdout_coordinates <- as.matrix(
  holdout_data[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
)
if (any(!is.finite(training_coordinates)) ||
    any(!is.finite(holdout_coordinates))) {
  stop("Regression centroid coordinates must be finite.")
}

training_sf <- st_as_sf(
  training_data,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)
holdout_sf <- st_as_sf(
  holdout_data,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

bandwidth_fractions <- c(0.35, 0.50, 0.65, 0.80, 0.95)
bandwidth_grid <- unique(pmin(
  nrow(training_data),
  pmax(
    ncol(X_train) + 2,
    ceiling(bandwidth_fractions * nrow(training_data))
  )
))
kernel_name <- "bisquare"

# gw.dist returns prediction-by-training distances; model fitting needs
# training-by-prediction distances.
holdout_distances <- t(gw.dist(
  dp.locat = training_coordinates,
  rp.locat = holdout_coordinates,
  longlat = TRUE
))
training_distances <- t(gw.dist(
  dp.locat = training_coordinates,
  longlat = TRUE
))
holdout_weights <- lapply(bandwidth_grid, function(bandwidth) {
  gw.weight(
    holdout_distances,
    bw = bandwidth,
    kernel = kernel_name,
    adaptive = TRUE
  )
})
```

### GWmodel bandwidth selection

`GWmodel::gwr.predict()` estimates local year effects and predictor slopes from the 2020–2024 observations, then predicts each 2025 centroid. The 2025 year indicators are set to the linear extrapolation weights above.

```{r}
gwmodel_holdout_predictions <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(holdout_data),
  ncol = length(bandwidth_grid)
)
for (bandwidth_index in seq_along(bandwidth_grid)) {
  gwr_holdout_fit <- gwr.predict(
    model_formula,
    data = training_sf,
    predictdata = holdout_sf,
    bw = bandwidth_grid[bandwidth_index],
    kernel = kernel_name,
    adaptive = TRUE,
    longlat = TRUE,
    dMat1 = holdout_distances,
    dMat2 = training_distances
  )
  gwmodel_holdout_predictions[, bandwidth_index] <-
    gwr_holdout_fit$SDF$prediction
}

gwmodel_bandwidth_results <- data.frame(
  bandwidth_neighbors = bandwidth_grid,
  bandwidth_fraction = bandwidth_grid / nrow(training_data),
  holdout_RMSE = apply(gwmodel_holdout_predictions, 2, function(prediction) {
    sqrt(mean((y_holdout - prediction)^2))
  }),
  holdout_R_squared = apply(gwmodel_holdout_predictions, 2, function(prediction) {
    1 - sum((y_holdout - prediction)^2) / holdout_total_sum_squares
  })
)
selected_gwmodel_index <- which.min(gwmodel_bandwidth_results$holdout_RMSE)
selected_gwmodel_bandwidth <-
  gwmodel_bandwidth_results$bandwidth_neighbors[selected_gwmodel_index]
best_gwmodel_holdout_predictions <-
  gwmodel_holdout_predictions[, selected_gwmodel_index]

write.csv(
  gwmodel_bandwidth_results,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "gwmodel_bandwidth_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
cat(sprintf(
  "Selected GWmodel bandwidth: %d neighbors; holdout RMSE: %.6f\n",
  selected_gwmodel_bandwidth,
  gwmodel_bandwidth_results$holdout_RMSE[selected_gwmodel_index]
))
```

### CVXR locally weighted regression

CVXR solves the weighted regression for multiple prediction locations per problem. The intercept and year effects are unpenalized, matching the ridge model's treatment of \(\alpha_t\).

```{r}
cvxr_local_predict <- function(
  X,
  y,
  target_X,
  weights,
  lambda,
  penalty_indices,
  chunk_size = 20
) {
  predictions <- numeric(nrow(target_X))
  coefficient_estimates <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = ncol(X),
    ncol = nrow(target_X),
    dimnames = list(colnames(X), NULL)
  )

  chunk_starts <- seq.int(1, nrow(target_X), by = chunk_size)
  for (chunk_start in chunk_starts) {
    target_indices <- chunk_start:min(
      chunk_start + chunk_size - 1,
      nrow(target_X)
    )
    chunk_weights <- weights[, target_indices, drop = FALSE]
    local_coefficients <- Variable(
      shape = c(ncol(X), length(target_indices))
    )
    response_matrix <- matrix(
      y,
      nrow = length(y),
      ncol = length(target_indices)
    )
    weighted_residuals <- sqrt(chunk_weights) *
      (X %*% local_coefficients - response_matrix)
    objective <- sum_squares(weighted_residuals)
    if (lambda > 0) {
      objective <- objective +
        lambda * sum_squares(local_coefficients[penalty_indices, ])
    }

    fit <- solve(
      Problem(Minimize(objective)),
      solver = "CLARABEL",
      max_iter = 1000
    )
    if (!fit$status %in% c("optimal", "optimal_inaccurate")) {
      stop(sprintf(
        "CVXR local regression failed for lambda=%g with status: %s",
        lambda,
        fit$status
      ))
    }

    chunk_coefficients <- value(local_coefficients)
    coefficient_estimates[, target_indices] <- chunk_coefficients
    predictions[target_indices] <- rowSums(
      target_X[target_indices, , drop = FALSE] *
        t(chunk_coefficients)
    )
  }

  list(
    predictions = predictions,
    coefficients = coefficient_estimates
  )
}

lambda_grid <- c(0, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10)
cvxr_grid <- expand.grid(
  bandwidth_index = seq_along(bandwidth_grid),
  lambda = lambda_grid
)
cvxr_grid$bandwidth_neighbors <-
  bandwidth_grid[cvxr_grid$bandwidth_index]
cvxr_grid$holdout_RMSE <- NA_real_
cvxr_grid$holdout_R_squared <- NA_real_
cvxr_holdout_predictions <- vector("list", nrow(cvxr_grid))

for (grid_index in seq_len(nrow(cvxr_grid))) {
  holdout_fit <- cvxr_local_predict(
    X = X_train,
    y = y_train,
    target_X = X_holdout,
    weights = holdout_weights[[cvxr_grid$bandwidth_index[grid_index]]],
    lambda = cvxr_grid$lambda[grid_index],
    penalty_indices = feature_parameter_indices
  )
  cvxr_holdout_predictions[[grid_index]] <- holdout_fit$predictions
  residuals <- y_holdout - holdout_fit$predictions
  cvxr_grid$holdout_RMSE[grid_index] <- sqrt(mean(residuals^2))
  cvxr_grid$holdout_R_squared[grid_index] <-
    1 - sum(residuals^2) / holdout_total_sum_squares
}

selected_cvxr_index <- which.min(cvxr_grid$holdout_RMSE)
selected_cvxr_bandwidth_index <-
  cvxr_grid$bandwidth_index[selected_cvxr_index]
selected_cvxr_bandwidth <- bandwidth_grid[selected_cvxr_bandwidth_index]
selected_cvxr_lambda <- cvxr_grid$lambda[selected_cvxr_index]
best_cvxr_holdout_predictions <-
  cvxr_holdout_predictions[[selected_cvxr_index]]

write.csv(
  cvxr_grid,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "cvxr_gwmodel_hyperparameter_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
cat(sprintf(
  "Selected CVXR bandwidth: %d neighbors; lambda: %g; holdout RMSE: %.6f\n",
  selected_cvxr_bandwidth,
  selected_cvxr_lambda,
  cvxr_grid$holdout_RMSE[selected_cvxr_index]
))
```

### Persistent provincial outlier correction

The selected spatial models are fitted to the 2020–2024 observations at their own centroids to obtain training residuals. Provinces with a median residual more than three robust standard deviations from the cross-province median are flagged. For each flagged province, a linear trend in its training residuals is extrapolated to 2025 and added to spatial predictions. The correction is estimated using training years only and does not remove any observations.

```{r}
training_coordinates <- as.matrix(
  training_data[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
)
training_distances <- t(gw.dist(
  dp.locat = training_coordinates,
  longlat = TRUE
))
training_sf <- st_as_sf(
  training_data,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

selected_gwmodel_training_fit <- gwr.basic(
  formula = model_formula,
  data = training_sf,
  bw = selected_gwmodel_bandwidth,
  kernel = kernel_name,
  adaptive = TRUE,
  longlat = TRUE,
  dMat = training_distances
)
if (is.null(selected_gwmodel_training_fit$SDF$yhat) ||
    any(!is.finite(selected_gwmodel_training_fit$SDF$yhat))) {
  stop("GWmodel training fit did not return finite fitted values for outlier detection.")
}

training_weights <- gw.weight(
  training_distances,
  bw = selected_cvxr_bandwidth,
  kernel = kernel_name,
  adaptive = TRUE
)
selected_cvxr_training_fit <- cvxr_local_predict(
  X = X_train,
  y = y_train,
  target_X = X_train,
  weights = training_weights,
  lambda = selected_cvxr_lambda,
  penalty_indices = feature_parameter_indices
)

fit_province_residual_correction <- function(
  data,
  residuals,
  forecast_year,
  threshold = 3
) {
  residual_data <- data.frame(
    province = data$province,
    year = data$year,
    residual = residuals
  )
  province_residuals <- aggregate(
    residual ~ province,
    data = residual_data,
    FUN = median
  )
  robust_center <- median(province_residuals$residual)
  robust_scale <- mad(province_residuals$residual, constant = 1.4826)
  if (!is.finite(robust_scale) || robust_scale <= 0) {
    stop("Cannot identify provincial residual outliers: robust residual scale is zero.")
  }
  province_residuals$robust_z <-
    (province_residuals$residual - robust_center) / robust_scale
  province_residuals$outlier <- abs(province_residuals$robust_z) >= threshold
  province_residuals$residual_correction <- 0

  outlier_provinces <- province_residuals$province[
    province_residuals$outlier
  ]
  for (province in outlier_provinces) {
    province_data <- residual_data[
      residual_data$province == province,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    if (length(unique(province_data$year)) < 2) {
      stop(sprintf(
        "Cannot extrapolate residual trend for outlier province %s.",
        province
      ))
    }
    residual_trend <- lm(residual ~ year, data = province_data)
    forecast <- unname(predict(
      residual_trend,
      newdata = data.frame(year = forecast_year)
    ))
    if (!is.finite(forecast)) {
      stop(sprintf(
        "Non-finite residual correction for outlier province %s.",
        province
      ))
    }
    province_residuals$residual_correction[
      province_residuals$province == province
    ] <- forecast
  }

  province_residuals
}

gwmodel_outlier_corrections <- fit_province_residual_correction(
  training_data,
  y_train - selected_gwmodel_training_fit$SDF$yhat,
  holdout_year
)
cvxr_outlier_corrections <- fit_province_residual_correction(
  training_data,
  y_train - selected_cvxr_training_fit$predictions,
  holdout_year
)
write.csv(
  gwmodel_outlier_corrections,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "gwmodel_outlier_corrections.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  cvxr_outlier_corrections,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "cvxr_gw_outlier_corrections.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
print(gwmodel_outlier_corrections[
  gwmodel_outlier_corrections$outlier,
], row.names = FALSE)
```

### 2025 holdout comparison

The table reports each raw spatial prediction and the prediction after applying its training-only outlier correction. Provincial GDP targets are not used in model selection or this correction.

```{r}
gwmodel_holdout_correction <- gwmodel_outlier_corrections$residual_correction[
  match(holdout_data$province, gwmodel_outlier_corrections$province)
]
cvxr_holdout_correction <- cvxr_outlier_corrections$residual_correction[
  match(holdout_data$province, cvxr_outlier_corrections$province)
]
if (anyNA(gwmodel_holdout_correction) || anyNA(cvxr_holdout_correction)) {
  stop("Could not match all 2025 holdout provinces to the outlier-correction table.")
}
adjusted_gwmodel_holdout_predictions <-
  best_gwmodel_holdout_predictions + gwmodel_holdout_correction
adjusted_cvxr_holdout_predictions <-
  best_cvxr_holdout_predictions + cvxr_holdout_correction

holdout_model_comparison <- data.frame(
  model = c(
    "GWmodel GWR",
    "GWmodel GWR with outlier correction",
    "CVXR local regression",
    "CVXR local regression with outlier correction"
  ),
  bandwidth_neighbors = c(
    selected_gwmodel_bandwidth,
    selected_gwmodel_bandwidth,
    selected_cvxr_bandwidth,
    selected_cvxr_bandwidth
  ),
  lambda = c(NA_real_, NA_real_, selected_cvxr_lambda, selected_cvxr_lambda),
  R_squared = c(
    1 - sum((y_holdout - best_gwmodel_holdout_predictions)^2) /
      holdout_total_sum_squares,
    1 - sum((y_holdout - adjusted_gwmodel_holdout_predictions)^2) /
      holdout_total_sum_squares,
    1 - sum((y_holdout - best_cvxr_holdout_predictions)^2) /
      holdout_total_sum_squares,
    1 - sum((y_holdout - adjusted_cvxr_holdout_predictions)^2) /
      holdout_total_sum_squares
  ),
  RMSE = c(
    sqrt(mean((y_holdout - best_gwmodel_holdout_predictions)^2)),
    sqrt(mean((y_holdout - adjusted_gwmodel_holdout_predictions)^2)),
    sqrt(mean((y_holdout - best_cvxr_holdout_predictions)^2)),
    sqrt(mean((y_holdout - adjusted_cvxr_holdout_predictions)^2))
  )
)
print(holdout_model_comparison, row.names = FALSE)

holdout_predictions <- data.frame(
  province = holdout_data$province,
  year = holdout_year,
  actual = y_holdout,
  gwmodel_spatial_prediction = best_gwmodel_holdout_predictions,
  gwmodel_outlier_correction = gwmodel_holdout_correction,
  gwmodel_fitted = adjusted_gwmodel_holdout_predictions,
  gwmodel_residual = y_holdout - adjusted_gwmodel_holdout_predictions,
  cvxr_spatial_prediction = best_cvxr_holdout_predictions,
  cvxr_outlier_correction = cvxr_holdout_correction,
  cvxr_fitted = adjusted_cvxr_holdout_predictions,
  cvxr_residual = y_holdout - adjusted_cvxr_holdout_predictions
)
write.csv(
  holdout_predictions,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "gw_model_2025_holdout_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

holdout_plot_data <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    actual = y_holdout,
    fitted = best_gwmodel_holdout_predictions,
    model = "GWmodel GWR"
  ),
  data.frame(
    actual = y_holdout,
    fitted = adjusted_gwmodel_holdout_predictions,
    model = "GWmodel GWR with outlier correction"
  ),
  data.frame(
    actual = y_holdout,
    fitted = best_cvxr_holdout_predictions,
    model = "CVXR local regression"
  ),
  data.frame(
    actual = y_holdout,
    fitted = adjusted_cvxr_holdout_predictions,
    model = "CVXR with outlier correction"
  )
)
holdout_plot <- ggplot(
  holdout_plot_data,
  aes(x = actual, y = fitted, color = model)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "gray35") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "GWmodel GWR" = "#0072B2",
    "GWmodel GWR with outlier correction" = "#56B4E9",
    "CVXR local regression" = "#D55E00",
    "CVXR with outlier correction" = "#E69F00"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "2025 spatial-model holdout: actual vs fitted",
    x = "Actual GRDP per capita",
    y = "Predicted GRDP per capita",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(
  file.path(figure_output_dir, "gw_model_2025_holdout_actual_vs_fitted.png"),
  holdout_plot,
  width = 11.25,
  height = 6.875,
  dpi = 160
)
```

### Refit selected models and training diagnostics

Refit each method using all available regression years. The final year effects include separate 2020–2025 intercept terms; 2025 level-2 predictions use the 2025 term directly.

```{r}
final_training_data <- add_year_effects(
  prepare_features(regression_data),
  all_years
)
final_year_effect_columns <- paste0("year_", all_years[-1])
final_predictors <- c(final_year_effect_columns, scaled_feature_columns)
final_design_formula <- reformulate(final_predictors)
final_model_formula <- reformulate(
  final_predictors,
  response = "grdp_per_capita"
)
final_X <- model.matrix(final_design_formula, data = final_training_data)
final_y <- final_training_data$grdp_per_capita
final_feature_parameter_indices <- match(
  scaled_feature_columns,
  colnames(final_X)
)
if (anyNA(final_feature_parameter_indices)) {
  stop("Could not identify all final-model feature slopes.")
}

final_bandwidth_gwmodel <- min(
  nrow(final_training_data),
  max(
    ncol(final_X) + 2,
    ceiling(selected_gwmodel_bandwidth / nrow(training_data) *
      nrow(final_training_data))
  )
)
final_bandwidth_cvxr <- min(
  nrow(final_training_data),
  max(
    ncol(final_X) + 2,
    ceiling(selected_cvxr_bandwidth / nrow(training_data) *
      nrow(final_training_data))
  )
)
final_training_coordinates <- as.matrix(
  final_training_data[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
)
final_training_distances <- t(gw.dist(
  dp.locat = final_training_coordinates,
  longlat = TRUE
))
final_training_sf <- st_as_sf(
  final_training_data,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

final_gwr <- gwr.basic(
  formula = final_model_formula,
  data = final_training_sf,
  bw = final_bandwidth_gwmodel,
  kernel = kernel_name,
  adaptive = TRUE,
  longlat = TRUE,
  dMat = final_training_distances
)
if (is.null(final_gwr$SDF$yhat) ||
    any(!is.finite(final_gwr$SDF$yhat))) {
  stop("GWmodel final fit did not return finite training fitted values.")
}

final_cvxr_weights <- gw.weight(
  final_training_distances,
  bw = final_bandwidth_cvxr,
  kernel = kernel_name,
  adaptive = TRUE
)
final_cvxr_training_fit <- cvxr_local_predict(
  X = final_X,
  y = final_y,
  target_X = final_X,
  weights = final_cvxr_weights,
  lambda = selected_cvxr_lambda,
  penalty_indices = final_feature_parameter_indices
)

training_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  province = final_training_data$province,
  year = final_training_data$year,
  year_factor = factor(final_training_data$year),
  actual = final_y,
  gwmodel_fitted = final_gwr$SDF$yhat,
  gwmodel_residual = final_y - final_gwr$SDF$yhat,
  cvxr_fitted = final_cvxr_training_fit$predictions,
  cvxr_residual = final_y - final_cvxr_training_fit$predictions,
  mean_radiance = final_training_data$mean_radiance,
  population = final_training_data$population,
  pixel_count = final_training_data$pixel_count
)
training_diagnostics <- training_diagnostics %>%
  mutate(
    gwmodel_standardized_residual =
      gwmodel_residual / sd(gwmodel_residual),
    gwmodel_scale_location = sqrt(abs(gwmodel_standardized_residual)),
    cvxr_standardized_residual = cvxr_residual / sd(cvxr_residual),
    cvxr_scale_location = sqrt(abs(cvxr_standardized_residual))
  )
write.csv(
  training_diagnostics,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "gw_model_training_diagnostics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

training_total_sum_squares <- sum((final_y - mean(final_y))^2)
training_model_stats <- data.frame(
  model = c("GWmodel GWR", "CVXR local regression"),
  R_squared = c(
    1 - sum(training_diagnostics$gwmodel_residual^2) /
      training_total_sum_squares,
    1 - sum(training_diagnostics$cvxr_residual^2) /
      training_total_sum_squares
  ),
  RMSE = c(
    sqrt(mean(training_diagnostics$gwmodel_residual^2)),
    sqrt(mean(training_diagnostics$cvxr_residual^2))
  )
)
print(training_model_stats, row.names = FALSE)
```

The fitted-value and residual figures follow the linear model's diagnostic outputs. Training diagnostics are descriptive; local fits and spatially overlapping neighborhoods do not have independent residuals.

```{r}

diagnostic_scatter <- function(data, fitted_column, residual_column, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[fitted_column]], y = .data[[residual_column]])) +
    geom_point(color = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.55, size = 1.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Fitted values", y = "Residual") +
    theme_minimal()
}
diagnostic_qq <- function(data, residual_column, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(sample = .data[[residual_column]])) +
    stat_qq(color = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.55) +
    stat_qq_line(color = "#D55E00") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Theoretical quantiles", y = "Sample quantiles") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

### 2025 level-2 predictions

Use the refitted model's 2025 year effect and the training-set feature standardization to predict each level-2 centroid. As in the linear model, a province-specific additive adjustment calibrates level-2 predictions to the reported 2025 provincial GRDP-per-capita target.

```{r}
prediction_data$year <- 2025
prediction_data <- add_year_effects(prediction_data, all_years)
final_prediction_X <- model.matrix(
  final_design_formula,
  data = prediction_data
)
if (!identical(colnames(final_prediction_X), colnames(final_X))) {
  stop("Level-2 prediction design does not match the final fitted model.")
}

prediction_coordinates <- as.matrix(
  prediction_data[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
)
if (any(!is.finite(prediction_coordinates))) {
  stop("Level-2 centroid coordinates must be finite.")
}
prediction_sf <- st_as_sf(
  prediction_data,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)
prediction_distances <- t(gw.dist(
  dp.locat = final_training_coordinates,
  rp.locat = prediction_coordinates,
  longlat = TRUE
))
final_gwr_predictions <- gwr.predict(
  formula = final_model_formula,
  data = final_training_sf,
  predictdata = prediction_sf,
  bw = final_bandwidth_gwmodel,
  kernel = kernel_name,
  adaptive = TRUE,
  longlat = TRUE,
  dMat1 = prediction_distances,
  dMat2 = final_training_distances
)
raw_gwmodel_predictions <- final_gwr_predictions$SDF$prediction

prediction_weights <- gw.weight(
  prediction_distances,
  bw = final_bandwidth_cvxr,
  kernel = kernel_name,
  adaptive = TRUE
)
final_cvxr_prediction_fit <- cvxr_local_predict(
  X = final_X,
  y = final_y,
  target_X = final_prediction_X,
  weights = prediction_weights,
  lambda = selected_cvxr_lambda,
  penalty_indices = final_feature_parameter_indices
)
raw_cvxr_predictions <- final_cvxr_prediction_fit$predictions

gwmodel_prediction_correction <- gwmodel_outlier_corrections$residual_correction[
  match(prediction_data$level_1, gwmodel_outlier_corrections$province)
]
cvxr_prediction_correction <- cvxr_outlier_corrections$residual_correction[
  match(prediction_data$level_1, cvxr_outlier_corrections$province)
]
if (anyNA(gwmodel_prediction_correction) ||
    anyNA(cvxr_prediction_correction)) {
  stop("Could not match all level-2 provinces to the outlier-correction table.")
}
adjusted_gwmodel_predictions <-
  raw_gwmodel_predictions + gwmodel_prediction_correction
adjusted_cvxr_predictions <-
  raw_cvxr_predictions + cvxr_prediction_correction

calibrate_province_predictions <- function(raw_predictions, data) {
  if (length(raw_predictions) != nrow(data) ||
      any(!is.finite(raw_predictions)) ||
      any(!is.finite(data$population)) ||
      any(data$population < 0)) {
    stop("Level-2 predictions and populations must be finite and correctly sized.")
  }
  if (anyDuplicated(paste(data$level_1, data$name, sep = "\r"))) {
    stop("The level-2 prediction data contains duplicate units within a province.")
  }

  target_grdp <- provincial_grdp_data[["2025"]][
    match(data$level_1, provincial_grdp_data$province)
  ]
  province_population <- provincial_population_data[["2025"]][
    match(data$level_1, provincial_population_data$province)
  ]
  if (anyNA(target_grdp) || any(!is.finite(target_grdp)) ||
      anyNA(province_population) || any(!is.finite(province_population)) ||
      any(province_population <= 0)) {
    stop("Missing or invalid 2025 provincial GRDP or population target.")
  }

  provinces <- unique(data$level_1)
  adjustments <- setNames(numeric(length(provinces)), provinces)
  for (province in provinces) {
    index <- which(data$level_1 == province)
    level2_population <- sum(data$population[index])
    if (!is.finite(level2_population) || level2_population <= 0) {
      stop(sprintf("Province %s has no positive level-2 population.", province))
    }
    province_index <- match(province, data$level_1)
    target_total <- target_grdp[province_index] *
      province_population[province_index]
    predicted_total <- sum(data$population[index] * raw_predictions[index])
    adjustments[[province]] <- (target_total - predicted_total) / level2_population
  }

  calibrated_predictions <- raw_predictions + adjustments[data$level_1]
  province_check <- do.call(rbind, lapply(provinces, function(province) {
    index <- which(data$level_1 == province)
    province_index <- match(province, data$level_1)
    target_total <- target_grdp[province_index] *
      province_population[province_index]
    predicted_total <- sum(
      data$population[index] * calibrated_predictions[index]
    )
    data.frame(
      province = province,
      population = province_population[province_index],
      level2_population = sum(data$population[index]),
      target_grdp_per_capita = target_grdp[province_index],
      target_total_grdp = target_total,
      predicted_total_grdp = predicted_total,
      difference = predicted_total - target_total
    )
  }))
  if (any(abs(province_check$difference) >
          1e-8 * pmax(abs(province_check$target_total_grdp), 1))) {
    stop("Calibrated level-2 predictions do not match provincial GDP targets.")
  }

  list(
    raw = raw_predictions,
    calibrated = calibrated_predictions,
    adjustment = unname(adjustments[data$level_1]),
    target_grdp_per_capita = target_grdp,
    province_check = province_check
  )
}

gwmodel_calibration <- calibrate_province_predictions(
  adjusted_gwmodel_predictions,
  prediction_data
)
cvxr_calibration <- calibrate_province_predictions(
  adjusted_cvxr_predictions,
  prediction_data
)

gwmodel_level2_predictions <- data.frame(
  level_2 = prediction_data$name,
  level_1 = prediction_data$level_1,
  year = prediction_data$year,
  population = prediction_data$population,
  spatial_grdp_per_capita = raw_gwmodel_predictions,
  outlier_correction = gwmodel_prediction_correction,
  raw_grdp_per_capita = gwmodel_calibration$raw,
  province_adjustment = gwmodel_calibration$adjustment,
  predicted_grdp_per_capita = gwmodel_calibration$calibrated,
  province_grdp_per_capita_target_2025 =
    gwmodel_calibration$target_grdp_per_capita
)
cvxr_level2_predictions <- data.frame(
  level_2 = prediction_data$name,
  level_1 = prediction_data$level_1,
  year = prediction_data$year,
  population = prediction_data$population,
  spatial_grdp_per_capita = raw_cvxr_predictions,
  outlier_correction = cvxr_prediction_correction,
  raw_grdp_per_capita = cvxr_calibration$raw,
  province_adjustment = cvxr_calibration$adjustment,
  predicted_grdp_per_capita = cvxr_calibration$calibrated,
  province_grdp_per_capita_target_2025 =
    cvxr_calibration$target_grdp_per_capita
)

write.csv(
  gwmodel_level2_predictions,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "gwmodel_level2_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  cvxr_level2_predictions,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "cvxr_gw_level2_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  gwmodel_calibration$province_check,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "gwmodel_province_constraint_check.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  cvxr_calibration$province_check,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "cvxr_gw_province_constraint_check.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    model = final_gwr,
    formula = final_model_formula,
    year_effects = all_years,
    feature_columns = feature_columns,
    feature_means = feature_means,
    feature_sds = feature_sds,
    bandwidth_neighbors = final_bandwidth_gwmodel,
    bandwidth_fraction = selected_gwmodel_bandwidth / nrow(training_data),
    kernel = kernel_name,
    outlier_corrections = gwmodel_outlier_corrections,
    holdout_metrics = gwmodel_bandwidth_results[selected_gwmodel_index, ],
    training_metrics = training_model_stats[1, ]
  ),
  file.path(model_output_dir, "gwmodel_gwr.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  list(
    coefficients = final_cvxr_prediction_fit$coefficients,
    training_coefficients = final_cvxr_training_fit$coefficients,
    feature_names = colnames(final_X),
    formula = final_model_formula,
    year_effects = all_years,
    feature_columns = feature_columns,
    feature_means = feature_means,
    feature_sds = feature_sds,
    bandwidth_neighbors = final_bandwidth_cvxr,
    bandwidth_fraction = selected_cvxr_bandwidth / nrow(training_data),
    lambda = selected_cvxr_lambda,
    kernel = kernel_name,
    outlier_corrections = cvxr_outlier_corrections,
    holdout_metrics = cvxr_grid[selected_cvxr_index, ],
    training_metrics = training_model_stats[2, ]
  ),
  file.path(model_output_dir, "cvxr_gw_model.rds")
)

print(gwmodel_calibration$province_check, row.names = FALSE)
```
